nodes.text: A new deadly metapneumovirus (hMPV) has been recorded in China. The infection affects both children and adults. The main symptoms of the infection are cough, runny nose, shortness of breath, fever, headache, and a fifth of patients also have vomiting or loose stools. https://t.co/m1iBMBDEM9
